item.title: ‘GREATEST STRENGTH’: Religious communities join together for Bushey Interfaith Forum
item.description: Support for vulnerable local people was the theme of this year’s gathering of the Bushey Interfaith Forum. Councillors, residents and religious representatives met to discuss how faiths can help those in poverty or isolation. item.title: HERITAGE RESTORED: Pinner residents welcome refurb of historic cemetery entrance
item.description: The entrance to Paines Lane Cemetery has been given a much-needed upgrade, after a request from the Pinner Association to return the entranceway to its former glory. item.description: Boarding a plane to Brazil this summer, Valeria was equipped with luggage, creativity, and a desire to give back. item.description: A young Taekwon-do student from Chorleywood has been crowned the British champion after triumphing in a recent competition. item.description: Radlett residents were invited to a taste of treasure in December as Phillies Café in Radlett hid twelve gold coins around the village, mainly in and around the High Street.
